title: Nearness ends the frantic search
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 205
summary: The shabad opens in astonished intimacy: the Lord is no longer distant but known by grace. It carries the listener through anxiety cut away, pain and pleasure losing their tyranny, and ends with essence merging into Essence.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person worn out by searching, petitioning, and looking elsewhere for relief. Kept near, it teaches rest by revealing the nearness that restless effort keeps missing.
takeaway: Let grace make the Lord near enough to stop the chase.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karee kirapaa dhiaal beeThulai satigur mujheh bataio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: granting His Grace, my Kind Beloved has told me of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat kat dhekhau tat tat tum hee moh ih bisuaas hoi aaio ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਉ ਸੁਨਤੋ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kai peh karau aradhaas benatee jau sunato hai raghuraio ||1||
lines.translation: Unto whom should I pray? The Lord Himself hears all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਹਿਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੋਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: lahio sahasaa ba(n)dhan gur tore taa(n) sadhaa sahaj sukh paio ||
lines.translation: My anxiety is over. The Guru has cut away my bonds, and I have found eternal peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: honaa saa soiee fun hosee sukh dhukh kahaa dhikhaio ||2||
lines.translation: Whatever shall be, shall be in the end; so where can pain and pleasure be seen? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd kaa eko Thaanaa gur paradhaa khol dhikhaio ||
lines.translation: The continents and the solar systems rest in the support of the One Lord. The Guru has removed the veil of illusion, and shown this to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ਤਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੈਠੈ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan ik Thaiee tau baahar kaiThai jaio ||3||
lines.translation: The nine treasures of the wealth of the Name of the Lord are in that one place. Where else should we go? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਰਚਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekai kanik anik bhaat saajee bahu parakaar rachaio ||
lines.translation: The same gold is fashioned into various articles; just so, the Lord has made the many patterns of the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਇਵ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoiee hai iv tatai tat milaio ||4||2||123||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, my essence merges into God's essence. ||4||2||123||

structure: The shabad starts with grace making intimacy possible instead of merely imagined.
From there it loosens anxiety and the drama of pain and pleasure once the veil is removed.
The closing movement rests in the non-separation of essence meeting Essence through the Guru.
